scope: Six source/four-arm native PowerPoint sheets; source route overlays for BLIP, Attention, PERCEIVE and foreground masks for the latter two
verdict: Source-topology improvement confirmed on consumed samples; native output still distorts routes
observations: Attention transparent-gap source overlay follows four distinct upward shafts to the correct target. Strict masking leaves wrong gap-owner contacts. Native writer collapses four target sites to a side-center and produces overlapping elbow heads.
PERCEIVE source overlay follows both observed cornered paths. Native output replaces them with straight oblique chords and snaps attachments. Pair correctness alone is insufficient.
BLIP, HEVC and Reasoning retain three correct routes each. Oracle arm carries different original OCR/style, not a fair OCR improvement comparison.
Negative stays empty; its selected/oracle shape inputs were already empty.

Oracle Attention recovers only red-to-attention. Approximate manual boxes plus mask/attachment tolerance are not a strict upper bound; missing routes have fewer than two retained owner contacts. No oracle geometry rescue was performed.
